Tessa —

Renewal for our Redwood Dedicated deployment comes up Jan 15. Over the last 9 months we’ve pushed load hard and expect production traffic to increase again in Q2. We’re evaluating a renewal that includes additional reserved capacity rather than on-demand bursts. High level: we need approximately +24 GPUs (A100-equivalent) distributed across two zones, and would like formal throughput guarantees (p50/p95) for our long-tail batch jobs.

Two asks for you:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood can commit to a throughput SLO and support cross-zone redundancy for the uplift?
- As part of the renewal, we’re asking for a one-time concession on the renewal invoice (our legal/procurement expects some credits to offset migration/testing costs). What credit range is reasonable if we commit to 24 GPUs for 12 months?

I attached our expected token/throughput sheet and the current contract (redacted). Happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Thanks,

Greenwave Systems
